_notes: Multiplicative future-year discount applied ONLY to picks (assetClass=='pick')
in _compute_unified_rankings() before the global value sort.
Schema is OFFSET-from-current-draft-year so it never goes stale:
offset = pick_year - current_rookie_draft_year()
offset 0 -> the upcoming/current rookie draft -> 1.00 (NO discount)
offset 1 -> next year, offset 2 -> the year after, etc.
offsets not listed fall back to fallbackBase ** offset.
current_rookie_draft_year() resolution order (see
src/api/data_contract.py::current_rookie_draft_year):
1. 'currentDraftYear' below, if set (manual override; null = off).
2. else DERIVED FROM THE SCRAPE: the lowest year that still has
slot-specific 'YYYY Pick R.SS' rows IS the active rookie draft
(vendors publish full slots for the next class, generic tiers
for further-out years). This self-rolls the instant the data
sources advance to the next class -- no config edit, no stale
baseline, and the board stays internally consistent. Once your
league drafts a class the sources roll too, so 'current'
advances on its own.
3. else date-derived fallback: calendar year rolled to year+1
once today is on/after (rolloverMonth, rolloverDay). Only used
when no scrape is available (cold start / tests).
Legacy absolute-year 'baselineYear'/'discounts' keys are still read
for backward compatibility if 'offsetDiscounts' is absent.
This config is loaded by src/api/data_contract.py::_load_pick_year_discount.
